research_scope: Supplement the existing B150 20-item source hold register, not replace original 1900 facsimile verification.
original_work: Giuseppe Pitrè, Feste patronali in Sicilia, 1900, Biblioteca delle tradizioni popolari siciliane, volume XXI
global_guard: All 20 printed/PDF page indices UNKNOWN; original OCR line numbers must never be mistaken for page numbers; no visual 1900 page was verified in this pass.

family_sources.scope: Ribera-only historical St Joseph altars, Straula and Holy Family representation; cannot corroborate other Sicilian towns.
Catania municipal source distinguishes ornate guild candelore from the reliquary fercolo.
Syracuse diocesan feast source documents distinct 13 December and May Patronage observances.
Melilli report documents barefoot pilgrims and spoken invocations, not an original 1900 transcript.
UNESCO Sicily education heritage documents lavender aroma and votive offerings, not a specific herbal blessing.
Municipal 2026 notice separately lists offertory procession and saint-image procession.
Caltanissetta municipality documents St Michael festival on 8 May; another city page documents 29 September.
